title: Cyclic Integration by Parts (Solving for the Unknown Integral)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

steps.title: First Integration by Parts
steps.mathExpression: I = \int e^x \cos(x) dx; \quad u = \cos(x), \; dv = e^x dx \implies I = e^x \cos(x) + \int e^x \sin(x) dx

steps.title: Second Integration by Parts on Remaining Integral
steps.mathExpression: u = \sin(x), \; dv = e^x dx \implies \int e^x \sin(x) dx = e^x \sin(x) - \int e^x \cos(x) dx = e^x \sin(x) - I
steps.explanation: The original integral I reappears on the right side.

steps.title: Solve Algebraically for I
steps.mathExpression: I = e^x \cos(x) + e^x \sin(x) - I \implies 2I = e^x(\cos(x) + \sin(x)) \implies I = \frac{e^x}{2}(\cos(x) + \sin(x)) + C
steps.explanation: Add I to both sides and divide by 2.
